limitations: Fee income is an interval proxy, not feeGrowthInside or claimed-fee truth.
Exit quotes are live minimum-received evidence at observation time, not fills.
The current minimum reaction interval is 15 minutes.
DefiLlama APY is a screening proxy, not realized PnL.
Stable Carry and Gauge Farm forward values integrate observed APY paths but remain non-realized proxies until reward-sale, depeg and exit-quote adapters are implemented.
Blue-chip CL requires price, range, inventory, IL and exit-quote adapters before any profitability claim.
Earlier-version observations remain in the audit ledger but are excluded from global-lp-strategy-research-v0.9 allocation and forward-performance aggregates.
Address-bound token and reward prices are persisted at every scan; they support depeg and price-path analysis but do not replace exact pool inventory or executable exit quotes.
Capital without an eligible candidate remains explicit idle cash; the engine never force-allocates it.
Gauge Candidate Lab tests every shortlisted Gauge with equal virtual notional across competing harvest and defense policies; its proxy capital is not added to model-portfolio capital.

Operation-policy rolling OOS uses DefiLlama APY and TVL history only; every result is a diagnostic proxy and cannot support a profitability claim until exact tick, inventory, realized fee/reward and executable cost evidence is connected.

Uniswap v3 exact-position evidence is read-only and forward-looking: it fixes a hypothetical range and liquidity, records onchain inventory and fee-growth deltas, but cannot support a profitability claim without matured intervals and executable exit, swap and gas quotes.

Aerodrome Gauge exact evidence is read-only: it records active pool/gauge identity, fixed hypothetical LP inventory and current emissions; interval rewards are exact only when reward rate and staked supply remain unchanged between observations, and pool fee indices are reference-only because Gauge-staker fee attribution is not established.
No paper or live entry authority is granted by this research ledger.
